approvers: Managing director and the main contractor/developer
reason: We don't outsource this today and I'd be adding a new supplier and budget line. Tape and film cost a fraction of this, and if a coating marks coated glass or a frame when it peels, we pay for the repair.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the coated glass when it comes off, who pays? The glass and frame manufacturers exclude it, and a test panel doesn't prove it after 12 months in the sun.
instead: Keep using protection film and tape on the glazing, applied by our own crew, and take care at handover.
would_change_my_mind: Written approval from the glass and frame manufacturers, plus a signed guarantee that ACHV pays for any damage when the coating comes off, backed by insurance.
